hero.title: Books we have actually read
hero.subhead: A small catalogue, chosen by hand and posted from Bristol. When a title sells out we take it down rather than order more.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.lede: From finding your next book to holding it in your hands.

find.title: Find your next book
find.body: Browse our carefully selected collection and find something worth reading.

order.title: Place your order
order.body: Add your book to the cart, enter your details, and complete your payment securely.

receive.title: Receive your book
receive.body: We prepare your order with care and deliver it to your doorstep.

selected.title: Carefully selected
selected.body: Not thousands of titles. Just books we believe deserve your time.

recommended.title: Personally recommended
recommended.body: We read, explore, and recommend books we'd genuinely share with a friend.

empty.title: Nothing on the shelf fits that
empty.description: Try a shorter search, or drop a genre to widen the results.

summary.title: Summary
summary.note: Postage is calculated from the address you give at checkout.
